core_memory.user_introduction: Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer living in Seattle. He is interested in high-quality coffee machines that fit his design aesthetic.

archival_memory.product_info: We have a range of coffee machines that might interest you. Our standard drip coffee makers are known for their sleek designs and user-friendly features. Our espresso machines, on the other hand, offer a more premium experience with advanced brewing capabilities. Let me provide you with more details on both options if you'd like.
